name: HPageBreak
remarks: The HPageBreak object is a member of the HPageBreaks collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPageBreak value that represents the page break type.

properties.name: Extent
properties.description: Returns the type of the specified page break: full-screen or only within a print area. Can be either of the following XlPageBreakExtent constants: xlPageBreakFull or xlPageBreakPartial. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Returns or sets the cell (a Range object) that defines the page-break location. Horizontal page breaks are aligned with the top edge of the location cell. Read/write Range.

methods.name: DragOff
methods.signature: DragOff(Direction As XlDirection, RegionIndex As Long)
methods.description: Drags a page break out of the print area.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: The direction in which the page break is dragged.

parameters.name: RegionIndex
parameters.description: The print-area region index for the page break (the region where the mouse pointer is located when the mouse button is pressed if the user drags the page break). If the print area is contiguous, there's only one print region. If the print area is discontiguous, there's more than one print region.
